# Chat Downloader (Download Claude conversations)
> Free Chrome extension to download Claude.ai chats as Markdown, JSON, plain text, XML, or PNG. Also called Claude Chat Downloader and Claude Conversation Downloader.

- Home: https://chat-downloader.com/
- How to download a Claude chat: https://chat-downloader.com/how-to-download-claude-chat/
- How to export a Claude chat: https://chat-downloader.com/how-to-export-claude-chat/
- Export Claude chat: https://chat-downloader.com/export-claude-chat/
- Claude conversation extractor: https://chat-downloader.com/claude-conversation-extractor/
- Claude Code export (CLI, not this extension): https://chat-downloader.com/claude-code-export/
- Bulk / entire history: https://chat-downloader.com/bulk/
- Formats: https://chat-downloader.com/formats/
- Features: https://chat-downloader.com/features/
- How it works: https://chat-downloader.com/how-it-works/
- Privacy: https://chat-downloader.com/privacy/

Facts:
- Claude.ai has no built-in per-chat download button.
- Official Anthropic export is Settings → Privacy → Export data (account JSON ZIP).
- This product exports Markdown, JSON, plain text, XML, and PNG. It does not export PDF.
- Google sign-in is required before the first export; conversation content is generated locally as a file and is not uploaded to the product's servers.
- Claude Code (terminal) is a different product: use /export or JSONL under ~/.claude/projects. This Chrome extension does not read Claude Code sessions.
